long_description:
Rejoy Health is the AI care team for clinics. AI workers for healthcare that run the day end to end, from the first call to the last note.

Every missed call is a patient you never see. Every hour after clinic is time you don’t get back. Phones go unanswered, the schedule has holes, and clinicians are still charting, coding, and looking things up while the next patient waits. Rejoy takes that work off the team’s plate.

The AI Receptionist answers around the clock, books and reschedules visits, and never puts a patient on hold, so the calendar stays full. In the room, the AI Scribe turns the conversation into structured notes, the AI Interpreter handles live language in English, Spanish, French, Chinese, Korean, and more, and RejoyGPT plus clinical decision support answer questions while the patient is still there. After the visit, the AI Coder suggests ICD-10 and CPT codes so billing goes out cleaner and faster. A medical search engine and study companion sit in the same suite for guidelines, journals, and exam prep.

Not another chatbot. One system for doctors, nurses, MAs, and the front desk. More accurate than ChatGPT. HIPAA-compliant. Trusted by 40,000+ clinicians at leading US hospitals and health systems.

You stay in charge. Rejoy does the work. Book more patients. See more patients. Chart less.
name: Rejoy Health
one_liner: AI workers that book, scribe, code, interpret, and answer clinicians
